title: Mapsly Meta Ad Library Scraper Input

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Advertiser names or keywords to search the Ad Library for. Provide this OR pageIds (or both).

pageIds.title: Facebook Page IDs
pageIds.description: Exact Facebook Page IDs to pull every ad for (more precise than a keyword search).

pageUrls.title: Facebook Page URLs / handles
pageUrls.description: FB page handles or URLs (e.g. 'theinjectionistcanada' or 'https://www.facebook.com/theinjectionistcanada/'). Resolved to numeric page ids in the warmed session, then pulled like pageIds — the precise path seeded from a business's website Facebook link.

searchType.title: Search type (for searchTerms)
searchType.description: How searchTerms match: keyword_unordered / keyword_exact_phrase match AD TEXT (broad, noisy); page matches an advertiser PAGE NAME (precise).

countries.title: Countries (ISO alpha-2)
countries.description: Country the ads reached, e.g. CA, US. The first entry drives the proxy geolocation.

maxItems.title: Max ads per search
maxItems.description: Hard cap on ads collected per search term / page.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy configuration. Residential is strongly recommended for Meta.
